plugins.name: github-workflow
plugins.description: Development workflow plugin for GitHub story work and for work that stays on your machine. Say 'start the next story' and it picks an issue from your backlog, plans it, builds it, runs tests, opens a PR, has the PR reviewed independently by agents in a fresh context, and merges it on projects that turn on auto-merge. Selection reads org issue fields (Stage, Priority, Effort, Ownership) and the Epic and Feature tree, never labels or board cards, and a scheduled board-sync keeps every issue's Stage in step. For local work, 'build this' plans, builds, verifies and commits with no issue or PR, and code-review reviews a local change as well as a PR. One grill skill runs every interview. Keeps what loads into each session small.
